paper_title: Let the Expert Stick to His Last Expert-Specialized Fine-Tuning for   Sparse Architectural Large Language Models
caption: Top Expert distribution for specific tasks. Shaded areas represent variance across layers. The figure shows that few experts handle most gate values, highlighting expert specialization for different tasks.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the normalized average gate value for several tasks as a function of the number of experts. The x-axis, labeled “Experts,” utilizes a linear scale ranging from 1 to 64 with tick intervals of 1, and represents the number of experts. The y-axis, labeled “Normalized Average Gate Value,” has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.20, with tick intervals of 0.05. A horizontal dashed line is positioned at a value of 0.10. The red line, representing “Intent,” begins at approximately 0.18 and decreases to approximately 0.12 by the end of the x-axis. The blue line, representing “Summary,” starts at approximately 0.16 and decreases to approximately 0.09. The green line, representing “Law,” initially increases from approximately 0.12 to approximately 0.15, then decreases to approximately 0.10. The yellow line, representing “Translation,” starts approximately 0.14 and decreases to approximately 0.08. The purple line, representing “Math,” begins at approximately 0.13 and decreases to approximately 0.06. The gray line, representing “Code,” starts at approximately 0.07 and decreases to approximately 0.03. The teal line, representing “Uniform,” begins at approximately 0.07 and decreases to approximately 0.02.
